name: claude-cli-browser-terminal
description: Run Claude Code in a browser tab: the terminal on the left, Claude's last reply on the right as readable markdown.

scripts.watch:about: echo Rebuilds dist/ on every change in web/. Run it first, in its own terminal. Why: scripts/build-watch/README.md
scripts.ccw:about: echo Starts a session. Refuses to start without pnpm watch, so the page is never stale. Why: scripts/build-watch/README.md
scripts.release:about: echo Needs entries under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md. Builds, bumps the patch version, stamps the changelog, commits and tags, packs into published-versions/, pushes.
scripts.release: vite build && pnpm version patch && pnpm pack --pack-destination published-versions && pnpm pack --out published-versions/claude-cli-browser-terminal.tgz && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test: vite build && cross-env CC_WEB_PORT=7682 node server.mjs --model haiku
